verdict.rationale: FreshBooks marketing copy says users can link a bank account and run automated bank reconciliation workflows, which supports the core idea of reconciling bank accounts. The evidence does not show how reconciliation actually works or what the accountant reviews. The double-entry chart of accounts and journal entries confirm a ledger exists to reconcile against. Missing for 10: per-account reconciliation against the ledger, matched/unmatched transaction views, duplicate-transaction detection, a review workflow, in-depth reconciliation docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
